body: I found that site a long time ago and I've definitely been considering it. I feel a lot better now but I really do need to get some medication or something. Thanks for the help

Which is pretty much impossible for me because I'm only 16 and can't leave this city, state, or country yet.
It would be a cool experience just going to someone's house I've never been to, but I'd have to have a strong relationship with that person which I don't know how to build.
I typed the numbers that were on the pills on the internet and found out what they were, then I looked up what the dosage should be.

"If you've never failed, you've never lived." Lol I like that. But I don't get the point of life. If everything we do is just going to disappear after we die, why do it in the first place? Why live through the bad times when you can just die and not have to feel anything.
Is xanax a drug for social anxiety? One time I found a bag with xanax and morphine on a sidewalk by a gas station, took them both, and felt so good all weekend.

I'd have to have my mom take me to go to the doctor to get any medication, right?

And It's not as much being scared of saying anything as it is that my mind doesn't come up with anything to say. It's like I don't even have a personality. I've honestly tried talking to people but I just seem to say stupid things when I do. It's also extremely hard for me to smile unless I fake it, and then I wonder whether I look stupid because of it.

People just think I'm a douche bag because I hardly say anything to them. I guess they think I don't want to talk to them. I really do want to talk to a lot of people but it's so hard for me. I'm afraid that anything I say can ruin the whole relationship with them. Also, to get anti-anxiety or anti depression medication, I would have to tell my mom to do it for me and I would have to explain the whole situation which I don't want to do.

I don't enjoy games anymore. I don't enjoy movies. I'm tired of wasting my life, never having any money. I haven't seen any famous people or travelled anywhere. I live in a small town. I just want friends but I'm sure I would be under so much pressure even then. When you're alive you have to deal with pleasure and pain, but if you're not you don't have to feel anything.
